name: [Spellbook 1174-2404-6678] Infinite mana lands you control can produce, Infinite green mana, Infinite landfall triggers, Phase out any number of creatures any number of times

other: Notable prerequisites: You control at least five creatures.

Spellbook description: Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's third ability by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out up to one target creature.
Repeat any number of times.
